nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) _balances tracking token balances of every holder in ERC20.
Private nested mapping _allowed[owner][spender] storing ERC20 allowances in ERC20.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total number of minted tokens in ERC20.
Private string _name of the token ('League of Shibas') in ERC20Detailed.
Private string _symbol of the token ('LSHIBAS') in ERC20Detailed.
Private uint8 _decimals (0) of the token in ERC20Detailed.
Constructor of LSHIBAS/ERC20Detailed that sets name, symbol, decimals and mints 1_000_000_000_000 tokens to msg.sender.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that delegates to _transfer(msg.sender, to, value).
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that delegates to _approve(msg.sender, spender, value).
Public transferFrom(from, to, value) performing _transfer plus allowance reduction for msg.sender.
Public increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue) increasing the caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
Public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue) decreasing the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Internal _transfer(from, to, value) validating the recipient and mutating _balances.
Internal _mint(account, value) increasing _totalSupply and _balances[account].
Internal _burn(account, value) decreasing _totalSupply and _balances[account].
Internal _approve(owner, spender, value) validating addresses and writing _allowed.
Internal _burnFrom(account, value) burning and then reducing the caller allowance.
Public burn(uint256 value) burning msg.sender's own balance.
Public burnFrom(address from, uint256 value) burning from another account through allowance.
Public view balanceOf(address owner) reading _balances.
Public view allowance(owner, spender) reading _allowed.
Public view totalSupply() reading _totalSupply.
Public view name() reading _name.
Public view symbol() reading _symbol.
Public view decimals() reading _decimals.
SafeMath.add(a,b) with overflow require(c >= a) guard.
SafeMath.sub(a,b) with underflow require(b <= a) guard.
SafeMath.mul(a,b) with overflow require(c / a == b) guard.
SafeMath.div(a,b) with division-by-zero require(b > 0) guard.
msg.sender is the only externally controlled actor, used for mint recipient, transfer/burn/approve owner and spender.
Privileged mint operation inside the constructor creating 1_000_000_000_000 tokens for the deployer with no access control.
Arithmetic subtraction _balances[from].sub(value) in _transfer, guarded by SafeMath.sub.
Arithmetic addition _balances[to].add(value) in _transfer, guarded by SafeMath.add.
Arithmetic addition _totalSupply.add(value) in _mint, guarded by SafeMath.add.
Arithmetic subtraction of value from _allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, guarded by SafeMath.sub.
